html:
Question 10
?

Which of the following describes the level surfaces of the function f(x,y,z)=x2+y2−ln⁡z?

a
A family of hyperbolic paraboloids: z=x2−y2+c
b
A family of curves: z=ex2+y2+c
c
A family of curves: z=ex2+y2−c
d
A family of curves: z=ln⁡(x2+y2+c)
e
A family of paraboloids: z=x2+y2+c
